title.narrative: Mid-Term Review (MTR) of Denmark’s support to the Global Water Security and Sanitation Partnership

description.narrative:
The objective of the MTR is to assess Denmark’s engagement with GWSP, identify potential needs for recalibration, and deliver strategic recommendations on:
• Are the GWSP’s five focus areas (sustainability, inclusion, institutions, financing, and resilience) delivering expected results? • The relevance of Denmark’s thematic focus areas and priorities as outlined in the project document. • Has GWSP effectively mobilized additional financing (public and private)? • Assessment in relation to poverty orientation and target group considerations (Gender Age and Disability (GAD)); Leaving No One Behind (LNOB); Human Rights-Based Approach (HRBA); and climate change and environmental considerations (targeting or mainstreaming). • Opportunities to increase Danish visibility and influence within GWSP and the World Bank. • The efficiency of current organizational arrangements between MFA, embassies, and other stakeholders. • Options for strengthening synergies between GWSP and Danish bilateral and multilateral engagements, including private sector and civil society involvement.
